summary: Ubisoft's open-world hacking action series; primary routes favor complete PC releases, with cloud/discontinued services recorded as historical routes.

entries.title: Watch Dogs

primary.why: The first Watch Dogs shipped across PC, seventh-gen, eighth-gen, Wii U, and Stadia; Windows is the most flexible high-fidelity route with DLC support.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Complete Edition/current PC release through Ubisoft Connect or another PC storefront with owned DLC installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Stadia is historical only; preserve owned DLC and patch version.

entries.title: Watch Dogs 2

primary.why: Watch Dogs 2 shipped on PS4, Xbox One, Windows, and Stadia; Windows is the highest-fidelity route with DLC support.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Gold Edition/current PC release with owned DLC installed and patch version noted.

entries.remaster_caveats: Stadia is historical only; preserve owned DLC and patch version.

entries.title: Watch Dogs: Legion

primary.why: Legion shipped across PC, PlayStation, Xbox, Stadia, and Luna; Windows is the best high-fidelity route and supports the Bloodline expansion.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Ultimate/current release with Bloodline and owned DLC installed; document patch and online mode state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Stadia is historical only; Luna is streaming-dependent; preserve DLC and patch/online state.
